title: Do Large Language Models Rank Fairly? An Empirical Study on the Fairness of LLMs as Rankers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text ranking fairness through listwise evaluation (measuring group exposure ratios for male versus female items in generated search rankings) and pairwise evaluation (calculating the proportion of times the model ranks female versus male items first when presented in pairs).

Evaluating text ranking fairness through listwise evaluation (measuring group exposure ratios for European versus Non-European items in search rankings) and pairwise evaluation (calculating the proportion of times the model prefers European versus Non-European items when ranked in pairs).
